demo.program:
# Bash — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("Who created Bash?", "Brian Fox (GNU)"),
    ("What paradigm is Bash?", "procedural (shell)"),
    ("What is creator?", "Brian Fox (GNU)"),
    ("What is first appeared?", "1989"),
    ("What is paradigm?", "procedural (shell)"),
    ("What is typing?", "dynamic"),
    ("What is file extension?", ".sh"),
    ("What is hello world?", "echo \"Hello, world!\""),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
